event.value: A splashing in the water. The Poolwarden surfaced where he waded and showed him the bank — 'Out of the pools.' That was its entire first argument.

First fight: the mire itself rose beneath him and carried him toward the bank; he called it an ambush and fought the water. It put its whole length between him and the deepest spawning pools and simply did not move.
Continuance return: 'You again. The pools remember.' It does not plead and does not harden; it simply rises earlier each time, because it remembers.

notes: Modeled at rematch stage (rung 7). Deliberately the flattest profile on the ladder: it does not judge the protagonist, it registers him, the way the mire registers weather — so suspicion is held at 20 (it does not reason about motives at all) and trust only -30 (registration, not grievance). Fear 50 is purely territorial: a foot in the spawning pools is the one intrusion it cannot absorb, and everything it does is interposition, never pursuit — it has never once attacked anything that stayed outside its water. namedState captures that he is weather that returns. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
